description:
Portable manual lint remover (reusable fabric shaver) is the quick way to make clothes and upholstery look new again. Sweep it over sweaters, T‑shirts, woollens, bedsheets, curtains, and sofas to lift lint, fuzz, fabric pills, and stubborn pet hair in minutes—no batteries, no sticky refills, no waste. It’s perfect before office wear, family functions, or guest visits when you want a clean, polished look fast.

The lightweight handle gives steady control, while the metal blade edge is designed to grab surface fluff without tearing most everyday fabrics when used gently. Compact enough for travel and easy to store in a drawer, this lint remover is a simple, budget-friendly tool for daily fabric care at home.
